name: Ben 10: Critical Impact
summary: Step into the shoes of Ben Tennyson, the beloved alien-shifting superhero from Cartoon Network, in Ben 10 Critical Impact! This action-adventure game puts you in the midst of intergalactic chaos as a meteor shower threatens Earth. Using the alien powers of Heatblast and Ghostfreak, you’ll embark on a fast-paced mission to protect the planet in true Ben 10 style. Whether you're a fan of the animated series or just love thrilling shooting games, this is a challenge you can’t miss.
